title_en: Interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Article 22, Paragraph 4 and Article 24, Paragraph 2, Item (3) of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China

articles.content_en: I. The provision in Article 22, paragraph 4 of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China that "persons from other parts of China who wish to enter the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall apply for approval" means that persons from all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, including children of Chinese nationality born in the mainland to Hong Kong permanent residents, regardless of the reason for which they seek to enter the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, shall apply for and obtain approval from the relevant authorities in their locality in accordance with the relevant laws and administrative regulations of the State, and shall hold valid documents issued by the relevant authorities before they may enter the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. It is unlawful for persons from all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, including children of Chinese nationality born in the mainland to Hong Kong permanent residents, to enter the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region without having undergone the corresponding approval procedures in accordance with the relevant laws and administrative regulations of the State.

II. The first three subparagraphs of Article 24, paragraph 2 of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China provide: "The permanent residents of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall be: (1) Chinese citizens born in Hong Kong before or after the establishment of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; (2) Chinese citizens who have ordinarily resided in Hong Kong for a continuous period of not less than seven years before or after the establishment of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region; (3) Persons of Chinese nationality born outside Hong Kong of those residents listed in subparagraphs (1) and (2)." The provision in subparagraph (3) regarding "persons of Chinese nationality born outside Hong Kong of those residents listed in subparagraphs (1) and (2)" means that regardless of whether the person was born before or after the establishment of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region, at the time of his or her birth, one or both of his or her parents shall be persons who meet the conditions set forth in subparagraph (1) or subparagraph (2) of Article 24, paragraph 2 of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China. The legislative intent elucidated in this Interpretation, as well as the legislative intent of other subparagraphs of Article 24, paragraph 2 of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China, has been reflected in the "Opinions on the Implementation of Article 24, paragraph 2 of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China" adopted at the Fourth Plenary Session of the Preparatory Committee for the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the National People's Congress on August 10, 1996.
After the promulgation of this Interpretation, the courts of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall take this Interpretation as the standard when citing the relevant provisions of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China. This Interpretation shall not affect the right of abode in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region obtained by the relevant litigants in connection with the judgment of the Court of Final Appeal of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region on the relevant cases on January 29, 1999. In addition, whether any other person meets the conditions set forth in subparagraph (3) of Article 24, paragraph 2 of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China shall be determined solely by this Interpretation.
